name: What are common painting challenges in bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What are common painting challenges in bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bathroom painting challenges include dealing with high humidity, which can lead to peeling paint or mildew. Poor ventilation exacerbates these issues. Other challenges involve working in tight spaces, around fixtures, and ensuring proper preparation to prevent future problems. Professional painters are adept at navigating these challenges to deliver a durable and aesthetically pleasing finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom painting challenges include high humidity, mildew, poor ventilation, and working in tight spaces. Proper prep is crucial.
